question: David has three sisters. Each of them has one brother. How many brothers does David have?
answer: David ka koi brother nahi hai. Uski teeno sisters mein se har ek ka exactly ek brother hai, aur woh brother khud David hai. Isliye family mein chaar bachche hain, teen girls aur ek boy, aur David akela boy hai.

question:
The Pauli exclusion principle states that
Options:
(A) no two electrons can have the same energy
(B) no two electrons can have the same four quantum numbers
(C) no two electrons can occupy separate orbitals
(D) no two electrons can pair up if there is an empty orbital available
reference_answer: (B) No two electrons can have the same four quantum numbers.
answer: Sahi uttar (B) hai: kisi parmaanu mein koi bhi do electron chaaron quantum sankhyaon ka ek hi samooh nahi rakh sakte. Isi kaaran har kakshak mein adhiktam do electron ho sakte hain, aur un dono ke chakran vipreet hone chahiye. Electronon ki urja ek samaan ho sakti hai, isliye vikalp (A) galat hai.

question:
Which of the following is not a hypothesis for why hominids walked on two legs?
Options:
(A) it freed the hands to carry things
(B) it allowed for braincase expansion
(C) it expended less energy than quadrupedalism for going long distances
(D) it allowed hominids to see greater distances
reference_answer: (B) Braincase expansion is not a hypothesis for bipedalism.
answer: सही उत्तर (B) है। द्विपादता मस्तिष्क के बड़े विस्तार से लाखों वर्ष पहले विकसित हुई थी, इसलिए इसे बड़ी कपाल-गुहा का कारण नहीं माना जाता। बाकी विकल्प मानक परिकल्पनाएँ हैं: सीधे चलने से हाथ चीज़ें ढोने के लिए खाली हुए, लंबी दूरी तय करने में ऊर्जा बची, और होमिनिड ऊँची घास के ऊपर दूर तक देख सके।

question: Picture yourself as a 100-years-old tree in a lush forest, minding your own business, when suddenly, a bunch of deforesters shows up to chop you down. How do you feel when those guys start hacking away at you?
answer: सौ वर्षों से मैं यहाँ खड़ा हूँ, ऋतुओं को बदलते देखता रहा हूँ, अपनी शाखाओं में पक्षियों को आश्रय देता रहा हूँ और मेरे तने से टेक लगाकर सुस्ताने वाले हर राही को छाया देता रहा हूँ। जब पहली कुल्हाड़ी मेरी छाल में धँसती है, तो मुझे दर्द से अधिक सदमा लगता है, एक गहरी कँपकँपी जो मेरी जड़ों से लेकर सबसे ऊँची पत्तियों तक दौड़ जाती है। फिर दुःख आता है: उन घोंसलों के लिए जो गिर जाएँगे, उन गिलहरियों के लिए जिनका घर छिन जाएगा, और उस मिट्टी के लिए जिसे मेरी जड़ों ने थाम रखा था। मैं न भाग सकता हूँ, न चिल्ला सकता हूँ, इसलिए बस यह आशा कर सकता हूँ कि कोई याद रखेगा कि जंगल केवल लकड़ी नहीं, बल्कि एक जीवित समुदाय है जिसे बढ़ने में सदियाँ लगीं।

question:
Which of the following does not occur with increasing age?
Options:
(A) A reduction in lean body mass
(B) A reduction in bone density
(C) An increased appetite
(D) Impaired immune function
reference_answer: (C) An increased appetite; appetite usually falls with age.
answer: सही उत्तर (C) है, भूख का बढ़ना। बढ़ती उम्र के साथ आमतौर पर वसा-रहित शरीर द्रव्यमान में कमी, अस्थि घनत्व में कमी और प्रतिरक्षा क्षमता में कमज़ोरी आती है। लेकिन भूख आमतौर पर उम्र के साथ घटती है, जिसे कभी-कभी वृद्धावस्था की अरुचि कहा जाता है।

question: One morning after sunrise, Suresh was standing facing a pole. The shadow of the pole fell exactly to his right. Can you tell me the direction towards which the shadow was pointing - east, south, west, or north? Explain your reasoning steps.
answer: Chhaaya pashchim disha ki or thi. Subah surya poorv mein ugta hai, isliye parchhaaiyaan pashchim ki or padti hain. Choonki chhaaya theek Suresh ke daayin or padi, isliye pashchim uske daayin or tha. Jis vyakti ke daayin or pashchim ho, uska munh dakshin ki or hota hai, isliye Suresh dakshin ki or dekh raha tha aur chhaaya pashchim ki or thi.

question:
Cerebrospinal fluid circulates around the brain between the
Options:
(A) skull and dura mater.
(B) dura mater and arachnoid mater.
(C) arachnoid and pia maters.
(D) pia mater and brain surface.
reference_answer: (C) Between the arachnoid and pia maters (the subarachnoid space).
answer: Sahi uttar (C) hai: jaaltaanika aur mridutaanika ke beech. Yah jagah avajaaltaanika avkaash kehlaati hai, jahaan pramastishk-meru drav mastishk aur merurajju ko gaddi ki tarah suraksha deta hai. Dridhtaanika sabse baahar khopdi se lagi hoti hai, aur mridutaanika seedhe mastishk ki satah se chipki rehti hai.

question: Please explain the differences between exothermic and endothermic reactions, and include the criteria you used to distinguish between them. Additionally, please provide a real-world example to illustrate your explanation.
answer: Exothermic reactions release energy to their surroundings, usually as heat, while endothermic reactions absorb energy from their surroundings. The main criterion is the enthalpy change, ΔH: it is negative for exothermic reactions because the products have less energy than the reactants, and positive for endothermic reactions. In practice, an exothermic reaction makes its surroundings warmer, and an endothermic one makes them cooler. Burning methane in a gas stove is exothermic, releasing heat for cooking. An instant cold pack is endothermic: when ammonium nitrate dissolves in water inside the pack, it absorbs heat and the pack feels cold.

question: You are a wildlife expert with a deep understanding of Indian animals, birds and their environment. You help farmers whose crops are often destroyed by wild animals. A farmer comes to you and says that herds of nilgai, wild boar and monkeys destroy the crops in his field almost every day. He does not want to harm these animals, but he also needs to protect his crop. Please suggest detailed solutions using Indian traditional knowledge, natural remedies and modern technology, so that the crop is protected and the animals are not harmed.
answer: Aap animals ko harm kiye bina kai methods combine karke apni crop bacha sakte hain. Traditional aur natural methods: field ke border par lemongrass, castor, chilli ya sisal jaisi thorny ya strong smell wali crops lagayein, jinse nilgai aur wild boar door rehte hain; cow dung, cow urine aur neem ya chilli ka mix spray karein, jiski smell unhe bhagati hai; aur guard dogs rakhein, jo monkeys aur wild boar ke against achha kaam karte hain. Modern methods: solar-powered electric fence lagayein, jo harmless shock deti hai, motion-sensor lights aur alarms ya predator sounds play karne wale bio-acoustic devices lagayein, aur bird-scaring tape use karein. Neighbouring farmers ke saath milkar poore area ki fencing karein, aur support schemes aur crop loss compensation ke liye forest department se contact karein.

question:
What was the required labor service owed to the king in return for the privilege of using property owned by the Incan empire?
Options:
(A) Khipu
(B) Mit'a
(C) Split inheritance
(D) Capacocha
reference_answer: (B) Mit'a.
answer: Sahi answer (B) hai, mit'a. Mit'a system ke under Inca empire ke households land use ke badle state ko periodically labour dete the, jaise state ke fields mein farming, roads banana ya army mein serve karna. Khipu knotted cords the jinka use record-keeping ke liye hota tha, aur capacocha ek ritual child sacrifice tha.

question:
In his discussion of the Divided Line, Plato says that, in contrast to mere belief or opinion, knowledge is a belief for which we give reasons or justifications by appealing:
Options:
(A) to what our senses reveal to us about how things appear to us, not how they  really are.
(B) beyond the Forms to images of goodness, beauty, and truth obtained from particular objects.
(C) to what we sincerely believe is true about the Forms based on our experiences in the world.
(D) beyond sense experience to unchanging ideas (Forms) that are perceived as rationally ordered.
reference_answer: (D) Beyond sense experience to unchanging, rationally ordered Forms.
answer: The answer is (D): by appealing beyond sense experience to unchanging, rationally ordered Forms. In the Divided Line, Plato places belief and opinion about the changing physical world below knowledge, which grasps the eternal Forms through reason. Sense experience can give only opinion, not knowledge.

question: Imagine you are participating in a race with a group of people. If you have just overtaken the second person, what's your current position? Where is the person you just overtook?
answer: Ab aap second position par hain. Second position wale person ko overtake karne ka matlab hai ki aapne uski jagah li hai, first position nahi, kyunki leader abhi bhi aapse aage hai. Jis person ko aapne abhi overtake kiya, woh ek position peeche chala gaya hai aur ab third position par hai.

question:
Traditionally art has been defined as _____.
Options:
(A) wealth
(B) utility
(C) representation
(D) well being
reference_answer: (C) Representation.
answer: सही उत्तर (C) है, निरूपण। प्लेटो और अरस्तू के समय से कला को पारंपरिक रूप से अनुकरण, यानी यथार्थ की नकल या निरूपण, माना जाता रहा। आधुनिक युग में इस परिभाषा को व्यापक चुनौती मिली, ख़ासकर अमूर्त कला से, जो किसी पहचानने योग्य वस्तु का चित्रण नहीं करती।

question:
Abraham Maslow proposed the idea that some motives are more imperative to survival than others. Which of the following approaches expresses this?
Options:
(A) Homeostatic regulation
(B) Goal-setting
(C) Expectancy-value
(D) Hierarchy of needs
reference_answer: (D) Hierarchy of needs.
answer: सही उत्तर (D) है, आवश्यकताओं का पदानुक्रम। मैस्लो ने मानव आवश्यकताओं को स्तरों में व्यवस्थित किया, जिसमें भोजन और पानी जैसी शारीरिक आवश्यकताएँ सबसे नीचे हैं, फिर सुरक्षा, अपनापन, सम्मान और अंत में आत्म-सिद्धि। आमतौर पर निचली, अधिक बुनियादी आवश्यकताएँ पूरी होने के बाद ही ऊँची आवश्यकताएँ व्यवहार को प्रेरित करती हैं।

question: What were the main methods Mahatma Gandhi used to challenge the social and political problems of his time?
answer: Gandhiji ka central method satyagraha tha, yaani "truth-force": opponents ko harm karne ke bajaye non-violent action aur suffering sehne ki willingness se injustice ko resist karna. Unhone 1930 ke Salt March jaise mass civil disobedience movements aur non-cooperation campaigns lead kiye, jinmein Indians ko British goods, courts aur schools boycott karne ke liye encourage kiya gaya. Unhone swadeshi aur khadi ko promote kiya aur logon ko self-reliance ke symbol ke roop mein Indian cloth spin karne aur pehenne ke liye urge kiya. Unhone fasting ko moral pressure ki tarah use kiya aur social evils ke against kaam kiya, untouchability ke against aur Hindu–Muslim unity ke liye campaign kiya. In sab mein unhone ordinary logon ko mobilise karne ke liye apne personal example aur simple living ka sahara liya.

question:
Which of the following statements best describes the UN Human Rights Council?
Options:
(A) The UN Human Rights Council has the power to impose economic sanctions on a state for human rights violations
(B) The UN Human Rights Council scrutinises the human rights records of member states on the Council and each member state of the UN
(C) The UN Human Rights Council replaced the Economic and Social Committee of the UN
(D) The UN Human Rights Council consists of 27 member states
reference_answer: (B) It scrutinises the human rights records of all UN member states.
answer: Sahi uttar (B) hai. Saarvbhaumik aavadhik sameeksha ke maadhyam se Maanavaadhikaar Parishad Sanyukt Raashtra ke har sadasya raajya ki maanavaadhikaar sthiti ki jaanch karti hai, jismein uske apne sadasya bhi shaamil hain. Parishad mein 47 sadasya hain, yah pratibandh nahi laga sakti, aur isne 2006 mein Maanavaadhikaar Aayog ka sthaan liya.

question:
When the Supreme Court decides to take a case on appeal it
Options:
(A) issues a writ of habeas corpus
(B) issues a writ of certiorari
(C) issues amicus curiae briefs
(D) engages in judicial review
reference_answer: (B) It issues a writ of certiorari.
answer: Sahi answer (B) hai: ye writ of certiorari issue karta hai. Writ of certiorari woh order hai jisse Supreme Court kisi lower court ke decision ko review karne ke liye agree karta hai, usually tab jab kam se kam chaar justices case sunne ke favour mein vote karein. Habeas corpus illegal detention se related hai, amicus curiae briefs outside parties file karti hain, aur judicial review laws ko strike down karne ki power hai.

question: Describe a vivid and unique character, using strong imagery and creative language. Please answer in fewer than two paragraphs.
answer: Boodhi Mrs. Kapoor ek aise corner par umbrellas bechti thi jahan kabhi baarish hoti hi nahi lagti thi. Woh ek dried apricot jitni chhoti aur wrinkled thi, lekin unki aankhein sunlight mein wet pebbles ki tarah chamakti thi. Unka shawl forty colours ke patches ko jodkar bana tha, aur unka claim tha ki har square kisi aise country se stitch kiya gaya tha jahan woh kabhi nahi gayi thi. Woh achanak bursts mein hasti thi, jaise boiling kettle overflow ho jaaye, aur har passer-by ka secret uske batane se pehle hi jaan leti thi. Bachche kasam khaate the ki unke umbrellas doosre skies mein khulte hain: ek snow se bhara, ek falling petals se, aur ek stars se.

question:
According to the Solar Nebular theory what are asteroids and comets?
Options:
(A) They are the shattered remains of collisions between planets.
(B) They are chunks of rock or ice that condensed long after the planets and moons had formed.
(C) They are chunks of rock or ice that were expelled from planets by volcanoes.
(D) They are leftover planetesimals that never accreted into planets.
reference_answer: (D) Leftover planetesimals that never accreted into planets.
answer: The answer is (D): they are leftover planetesimals that never accreted into planets. In the solar nebular theory, small bodies of rock and ice formed first and gradually stuck together to build planets. Asteroids and comets are the pieces that were never swept up, so they preserve material from the early solar system.

question:
In test construction and evaluation, validity refers to the degree to which a test
Options:
(A) measures what it purports to measure
(B) yields consistent results on successive administrations
(C) has been piloted and statistically analyzed
(D) includes norms based on a representative sample of the general population
reference_answer: (A) It measures what it purports to measure.
answer: The answer is (A): the degree to which a test measures what it claims to measure. A valid intelligence test, for example, should actually reflect intelligence rather than reading speed or cultural knowledge. Consistency of results across administrations is reliability, a different property.

question:
MIT’s Kerberos KDC server has a maximum ticket lifetime of 24 hours (for most user principals). What ensures that an expired Kerberos ticket can no longer be used?
Options:
(A) The Kerberos server (KDC) refuses to establish new connections between clients and servers for expired tickets.
(B) When a client connects to a server, the server sets a 24-hour timer to terminate the connection, which ensures a client cannot remain connected past the ticket’s maximum lifetime.
(C) When a client connects to a server, the server compares the ticket’s expiration time to the server’s current clock, and refuses to authenticate the user if the ticket expiration time is in the past.
(D) When a client connects to a server, the server sends a query to the KDC to check if the ticket is still valid with respect to the KDC’s clock, and refuses to authenticate the user if the KDC reports that the ticket is expired.
reference_answer: (C) The server compares the ticket's expiration time with its own clock.
answer: Sahi answer (C) hai. Har Kerberos ticket mein uska expiration time hota hai, toh jab client ticket present karta hai, server us time ko apni clock se compare karta hai aur ticket expire ho chuka ho toh authentication refuse kar deta hai. Server ko KDC se contact karne ki zaroorat nahi hoti, isliye Kerberos mein clocks ka roughly synchronized hona zaroori hai.

question:
The mutation in sickle-cell disease consists of:
Options:
(A) a deletion.
(B) a duplication.
(C) an insertion.
(D) a point mutation.
reference_answer: (D) A point mutation (a single base substitution).
answer: सही उत्तर (D) है, बिंदु उत्परिवर्तन। सिकल-सेल रोग बीटा-ग्लोबिन जीन में एक क्षार के प्रतिस्थापन से होता है, जिससे प्रोटीन के छठे स्थान पर ग्लूटामिक अम्ल की जगह वेलीन आ जाता है। इसमें कोई DNA हटता, दोहराया या जोड़ा नहीं जाता।

question:
Which language family contains Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, and Romanian?

Slavic aur Germanic Indo-European family ki alag branches hain, aur 'European' koi language family nahi hai.

question: Write a descriptive paragraph about a bustling marketplace, incorporating sensory details such as smells, sounds, and visual elements to create an immersive experience for the reader.
answer: The marketplace hummed from the first light of morning. Sacks of turmeric and red chilli powder glowed like small hills of sunset, and the air was thick with the smell of cardamom, frying pakoras and ripe mangoes. Vendors shouted prices over one another, a radio crackled with an old film song, and somewhere a pressure cooker whistled. Bright saris fluttered from wooden poles, brass pots flashed in the sun, and a cow wandered calmly between the stalls. Coins clinked, children tugged at their parents' hands, and every few steps the crowd parted for a cart piled high with cauliflowers.

question: Describe five principles for evaluating the digital transformation of the Indian economy.
answer: Five principles can guide an evaluation of India's digital transformation. First, access: measure how widely people can use digital services, including internet coverage, smartphone ownership and the gap between urban and rural areas. Second, inclusion: check whether women, the poor and older people actually benefit, for example through Aadhaar-linked services and UPI payments. Third, economic impact: assess effects on productivity, formalisation of businesses, jobs and the growth of start-ups. Fourth, security and trust: examine data protection, privacy and the level of online fraud. Fifth, sustainability and governance: ask whether digital public infrastructure is reliable, open, well regulated and able to keep improving over time.

question:
What is dualism?
Options:
(A) Dualism suggests that international and domestic law are part of a unified legal system
(B) Under dualism, international and domestic laws comprise distinct legal Systems
(C) Dualism suggests that international and domestic law are distinct but equal in hierarchy
(D) Dualism suggests that international and domestic law are distinct legal systems whereby domestic law always prevails
reference_answer: (B) International and domestic law are distinct legal systems.
answer: सही उत्तर (B) है। द्वैतवाद के अनुसार अंतरराष्ट्रीय कानून और घरेलू कानून दो अलग-अलग विधि प्रणालियाँ हैं, इसलिए कोई संधि किसी राज्य के भीतर तब तक प्रभावी नहीं होती जब तक राष्ट्रीय विधान उसे घरेलू कानून में परिवर्तित न कर दे। यह एकत्ववाद से भिन्न है, जो दोनों को एक ही विधि व्यवस्था के अंग मानता है।

question: Write a descriptive paragraph about the effects of the monsoon in India. Include sensory details such as the sound of rain, the earthy smell of wet soil and the greenery spreading all around, and also explain its effect on daily life and agriculture.
answer: Jab aakhirkaar Bhaarat mein monsoon aata hai, to pehli boondein teen ki chhaton par hazaaron nanhe haathon ki tarah thaap deti hain, aur jald hi baarish chaandi ki chaadaron jaisi garajti hui barasne lagti hai. Pyaasi dharti apni meethi, sondhi khushboo chhodti hai, geeli mitti ki vah gandh jiska sab poori garmi intezaar karte hain. Kuch hi dinon mein bhoore khet aur dhool bhari pahaadiyaan gehre hare rang mein badal jaati hain, aur mendhak tatha mor apni aawaazon se shaamon ko bhar dete hain. Rozmarra ka jeevan bhi badal jaata hai: sadkon par paani bhar jaata hai, relgaadiyaan der se chalti hain aur har jagah chhaate khil uthte hain, jabki bachche khushi se paani bhare gaddhon mein chhapaak-chhapaak karte hain. Kisaanon ke liye baarish swayam jeevan hai, jo taalaabon aur kuon ko bharti hai aur dhaan, kapaas tatha anya khareef faslon ki buvaai sambhav banaati hai, jo desh ka pet bharti hain.

question:
How many major powers are there in a multipolar system?
Options:
(A) 0
(B) 1
(C) 2
(D) 3 or more
reference_answer: (D) Three or more.
answer: सही उत्तर (D) है, तीन या उससे अधिक। बहुध्रुवीय व्यवस्था वह है जिसमें शक्ति तीन या उससे अधिक बड़ी शक्तियों में बँटी होती है, जैसे प्रथम विश्व युद्ध से पहले का यूरोप। एक शक्ति के प्रभुत्व वाली व्यवस्था एकध्रुवीय होती है, और दो प्रतिद्वंद्वी शक्तियों वाली व्यवस्था, जैसे शीत युद्ध, द्विध्रुवीय होती है।

question: Photosynthesis is a vital process for life on Earth. Could you outline the two main stages of photosynthesis, including where they take place within the chloroplast, and the primary inputs and outputs for each stage?
answer: Prakaash-sanshleshan ke do mukhya charan hote hain. Prakaash par nirbhar abhikriyaayein haritlavak ki thylakoid jhilliyon mein hoti hain. Inmein prakaash urja, jal aur vaahak anu ADP tatha NADP+ lagte hain, aur inse oxygen, ATP tatha NADPH bante hain. Prakaash se swatantra abhikriyaayein, yaani Calvin chakra, stroma mein hoti hain. Inmein carbon dioxide ke saath pehle charan se mile ATP aur NADPH ka upyog hota hai, aur inse glucose (sharkara G3P ke maadhyam se) banta hai, saath hi ADP aur NADP+ vaapas prakaash abhikriyaon ko mil jaate hain.

question:
Which of the following correctly states the relationship between the federal and state judiciaries?
Options:
(A) Federal courts are higher courts than state courts and may overturn state decisions on any grounds.
(B) The two are entirely autonomous, and neither ever hears cases that originate in the other.
(C) The two are generally autonomous, although federal courts may rule on the constitutionality of state court decisions.
(D) State courts are trial courts; federal courts are appeals courts.
reference_answer: (C) Generally autonomous, but federal courts may rule on the constitutionality of state decisions.
answer: Sahi uttar (C) hai. question: In Indian mythology, time is seen as cycles (yugas): Satya Yuga, Treta Yuga, Dvapara Yuga and Kali Yuga. How might this idea of the yugas be linked to the stages of human life (childhood, youth, adulthood and old age)? Does the idea of death and moksha change according to these yugas, and if so, does the rapid passing of life in the Kali Yuga affect our understanding of time and death?
answer: Chaaron yugon ko maanav jeevan ke darpan ke roop mein padha ja sakta hai. Satya aur pavitrata ka yug, Satyayug, bachpan jaisa hai; Tretaayug, jab dharm ghatne lagta hai, yuvaavastha jaisa hai; achchhaai aur buraai ke mishran waala Dvaaparyug apni zimmedaariyon aur sangharshon ke saath praudhaavastha jaisa hai; aur patan ka yug, Kaliyug, vriddhaavastha jaisa hai. Paaramparik granth moksh ko yug se jodte bhi hain: kaha jaata hai ki Kaliyug mein jeevan chhota aur kathin hai, isliye bhakti aur Ishvar ka naam-jap jaise saral maarg sujhaaye jaate hain. question:
Say's Law

reference_answer: (B) It is the basis of Classical economic analysis.
answer: Sahi answer (B) hai: ye Classical economic analysis ka basis hai. Classical economists ne iske basis par argue kiya ki general overproduction aur long-term unemployment ke chances kam hain, jis view ko baad mein Keynes ne reject kiya.

question:

question: Imagine you are Chanakya, the great economist and political scholar of ancient India. A king comes to you seeking advice on improving his kingdom's economy. Please explain how, in the present time, the kingdom's economy can be strengthened through the coordination of trade and agriculture. Your advice will help us in practical policymaking.
answer: O king, a kingdom's strength rests on its treasury, and the treasury rests on agriculture and trade working together. First, strengthen agriculture: build irrigation and storage, give farmers fair credit, good seeds and knowledge, and protect them from famine with reserves of grain. Second, link farms to markets: build roads, cold storage and fair marketplaces so that farmers sell directly and middlemen cannot exploit them. Third, encourage trade and processing: support industries that turn crops into higher-value goods, and promote exports while keeping duties moderate. Fourth, keep taxes fair and predictable, so that producers prosper and still fill the treasury. Finally, guard against corruption with honest officials and regular audits, for a leaking treasury weakens even a rich kingdom.

question: How have the Alps and Rhine River influenced settlement and agriculture in Western Europe? List three impacts.
answer: The Alps and the Rhine have shaped Western Europe in three main ways. First, the Alps acted as a natural barrier that limited movement and concentrated settlement in valleys and lowlands, while their passes became important trade routes. Second, the Rhine has served for centuries as a major transport corridor, so cities and industry grew along its banks, from Basel to Cologne and Rotterdam. Third, both support agriculture: Alpine meltwater feeds rivers that irrigate farmland, the Rhine valley's fertile soils and mild climate support vineyards and crops, and Alpine slopes are used for dairy farming and seasonal grazing.

question: Discuss the concept of solidarity in human societies. Analyse how collective action and mutual support help humans overcome challenges and achieve common goals.

question: Describe five key principles in evaluating an argument in analytical writing.
answer: Kisi argument ko evaluate karne mein paanch key principles help karte hain. Pehla, claim identify karein: clear hon ki author aapse exactly kya accept karwana chahta hai. Doosra, evidence examine karein: dekhein ki woh claim ko support karne ke liye relevant, reliable aur sufficient hai ya nahi. Teesra, reasoning test karein: logical gaps ya fallacies dhoondhein, jaise correlation ko causation samajh lena. Chautha, assumptions uncover karein: poochhein ki argument kin unstated beliefs par depend karta hai aur kya woh sahi hain. Paanchvaan, alternatives consider karein: un counterarguments ya doosri explanations ke baare mein sochein jinhe author ne ignore kiya hai, aur judge karein ki kya argument phir bhi tikta hai.

question: Consider a satellite that is in a circular orbit around the Earth. The speed of the satellite decreases. What will happen to the satellite's orbital radius and period of revolution? Please justify your answer using principles of physics.
answer: वृत्ताकार कक्षा में उपग्रह के लिए गुरुत्व ही अभिकेंद्र बल प्रदान करता है, इसलिए GMm/r² = mv²/r, जिससे v = √(GM/r) मिलता है। अतः कक्षीय वेग त्रिज्या के वर्गमूल के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती है: वृत्ताकार कक्षा में धीमे चलने वाले उपग्रह को पृथ्वी से अधिक दूर होना चाहिए। इसलिए यदि उपग्रह का वेग घटता है और वह वृत्ताकार कक्षा में बना रहता है, तो उसकी कक्षीय त्रिज्या बढ़ जाती है। उसका परिक्रमण काल, T = 2πr/v, भी बढ़ता है, क्योंकि पथ लंबा हो जाता है जबकि वेग घटता है; यह केप्लर के तीसरे नियम, T² ∝ r³, से मेल खाता है।

question:
Do individuals (physical) persons enjoy international legal personality in the same manner as States and international organisations?
Options:
(A) Individuals enjoy international legal personality, but this is limited
(B) Individuals enjoy unlimited international legal personality
(C) Individuals do not enjoy any international legal personality
(D) Individuals can only bring claims before international courts
reference_answer: (A) Yes, but their international legal personality is limited.
answer: The answer is (A): individuals have international legal personality, but it is limited. They hold certain rights under human rights law and can bear duties, for example criminal responsibility for war crimes, and some treaties let them bring complaints. However, they cannot make treaties or exercise the full range of rights that states have.

question:
A healthy man and woman are worried about having children because they are both carriers of sickle-cell disease. If the couple have a biological child, what is the chance that the child will inherit sickle-cell disease?
Options:
(A) 100%
(B) 75%
(C) 50%
(D) 25%
reference_answer: (D) 25%; both carriers pass the recessive allele with probability 1/2 x 1/2.
answer: Sahi answer (D) hai, 25%. Sickle-cell disease autosomal recessive hai, toh dono carrier parents ke paas ek normal aur ek sickle-cell allele hota hai. Bachche ko disease tabhi hogi jab use dono parents se sickle-cell allele mile, jiski probability 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4 hai.

question:

reference_answer: (A) From producing core tools to producing flakes.
answer: The answer is (A): from producing core tools to producing flakes. In the Levallois technique, a stone core was carefully shaped in advance so that a flake of predictable size and shape could be struck off. The flake itself became the tool, rather than the core being worked into a hand axe.

question:

question: What is the main problem associated with landfills in India, and what effective management practices and policies can be implemented to deal with it? In addition, can community participation and awareness campaigns make any special contribution in this direction?
answer: Main problem ye hai ki India ke landfills mein bahut zyada mixed, unsegregated waste pahunchta hai, isliye zyada tar urban dumps scientifically designed landfills ke bajaye overflowing open sites hain. Sadta hua organic waste methane release karta hai, jisse baar-baar fires lagti hain, aur leachate groundwater mein mil jaata hai, jisse aas-paas ke residents ki health affect hoti hai. Effective solutions source par hi waste ko wet, dry aur hazardous mein segregate karne se start hote hain, jaisa Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016 mein required hai. Wet waste se compost ya biogas banaya ja sakta hai, dry waste recycle kiya ja sakta hai, aur purane dumps biomining se clear kiye ja sakte hain. Community participation bahut zaroori hai: Swachh Bharat Mission jaise awareness campaigns households ki habits badalte hain aur segregation aur recycling ko practically successful banate hain.

question:

answer: The answer is (D), on the anterior side of the neck. The carotid pulse is felt in the front of the neck, just beside the trachea and below the angle of the jaw, where the common carotid artery runs. The other options describe the temporal, brachial and femoral pulse sites.

question:

reference_answer: (C) Replicate its genetic material and synthesize viral proteins.
answer: Sahi uttar (C) hai: yah apni aanuvanshik saamagri ki pratikriti banaata hai aur vishaanu protein sanshleshit karta hai. Influenza ek RNA vishaanu hai, jo apne RNA genome ki pratilipi apne RNA polymerase se banaata hai aur vishaanu protein banaane ke liye parposhi ke ribosome ka upyog karta hai. Yah retrovirus nahi hai, isliye yah reverse transcriptase se DNA nahi banaata aur na hi parposhi ke gunsootra mein judta hai.

question:
If both parents are affected with the same autosomal recessive disorder then the probability that each of their children will be affected equals ___.
Options:
(A) 1 in 4
(B) 1 in 2
(C) 2 in 3
(D) 1
reference_answer: (D) 1; every child is affected.
answer: Sahi uttar (D) hai: praayikta 1 hai. Autosomal aprabhaavi vikaar se prabhaavit vyakti mein rog waale allele ki do pratiyaan hoti hain. Yadi maata-pita dono prabhaavit hain, to dono keval rog waala allele hi aage de sakte hain, isliye har bachche ko do pratiyaan milti hain aur vah prabhaavit hota hai.

question:
During the early years of his administration, Reagan's foreign and defense policies emphasized
Options:
(A) nuclear disarmament.
(B) détente.
(C) anticommunism.
(D) international free trade.
reference_answer: (C) Anticommunism.
answer: Sahi uttar (C) hai, saamyavaad-virodh. Apne pehle kaaryakaal mein Reagan ne Soviet Sangh ko "dusht saamraajya" kaha, sena ka vistaar kiya aur videshon mein saamyavaad-virodhi aandolanon ka samarthan kiya, jise baad mein Reagan siddhaant kaha gaya. Ve 1970 ke dashak ki tanaav-shaithilya neeti se door hate, aur hathiyaar-niyantran samjhaute adhiktar unke doosre kaaryakaal mein hue.

question:
What was a main organizational change proposed by the 9/11 Commission with regard to the U.S. intelligence community?
Options:
(A) Creation of the Department of Homeland Security
(B) Moving the Department of Defense Intelligence Agencies to the CIA for better coordination
(C) Creation of the National Intelligence Director
(D) Moving the domestic intelligence component of the FBI to the CIA
reference_answer: (C) Creation of a National Intelligence Director.
answer: सही उत्तर (C) है: राष्ट्रीय खुफ़िया निदेशक का पद बनाना। 9/11 आयोग ने पाया कि अनेक खुफ़िया एजेंसियाँ आपस में जानकारी ठीक से साझा नहीं करती थीं, इसलिए उसने उनकी निगरानी और समन्वय के लिए एक ही अधिकारी की सिफ़ारिश की। कांग्रेस ने 2004 में राष्ट्रीय खुफ़िया निदेशक का पद बनाया।

question:
A digital signature needs a
Options:
(A) Private-key system
(B) Shared-key system
(C) Public-key system
(D) All of them
reference_answer: (C) Public-key system.
answer: Sahi uttar (C) hai, saarvajanik-kunji pranaali. Hastaaksharkarta aisi niji kunji se hastaakshar banaata hai jo keval uske paas hoti hai, aur koi bhi usse mel khaane waali saarvajanik kunji se uski jaanch kar sakta hai. Saajha-kunji pranaali yah siddh nahi kar sakti ki hastaakshar kisne kiye, kyonki dono pakshon ke paas ek hi kunji hoti hai.

question: Craft an intriguing opening paragraph for a fictional short story. The story should involve a character who wakes up one morning to find that they can time travel.
answer: Maya ki aankh apni daadi ke khaane ki khushboo se khuli, jo ajeeb tha, kyonki uski daadi ko guzre gyaarah saal ho chuke the. Rasoi ki deewaar par laga calendar 2009 dikha raha tha, uska phone bina internet waala ek bhaari-bharkam dibba tha, aur aaine mein das saal ki ek ladki Maya ki hi dari hui aankhon se use ghoor rahi thi. Dopahar tak usne niyam khoj liya: jab bhi vah kisi taareekh ke baare mein sochte hue soti, usi taareekh mein jaagti. Shaam tak usne samasya bhi khoj li. Har baar jab vah peechhe jaati, vartamaan mein kuch badal jaata, aur is baar uska chhota bhai ab astitva mein hi nahi tha.

question:
A student pushes a puck across a table, moving it from position x = 0 to position x = 0.2 m. After he lets go, the puck continues to travel across the table, coming to rest at position x = 1.2 m. When the puck is at position x = 1.0 m, which of the following is a correct assertion about the net force on the puck?
Options:
(A) The net force is in the negative direction, because the puck is moving in the positive direction but slowing down.
(B) The net force is down, because the puck is near the Earth, where gravitational acceleration is 10 m/s^2 downward.
(C) The net force is in the positive direction, because the student’s push caused the puck to speed up in the positive direction.
(D) The net force is zero, because the student’s push in the positive direction must equal the force of friction in the negative direction.
reference_answer: (A) Negative direction, because the puck is slowing down.
answer: The answer is (A): the net force is in the negative direction. At x = 1.0 m the student is no longer pushing, and the puck is moving in the positive direction while slowing down. Slowing down means its acceleration, and therefore the net force (friction), points opposite to its motion.

question:
Theories of racialized discourse suggest that:
Options:
(A) race is an objective way of categorizing people on biological grounds
(B) the idea of race is socially constructed through powerful ideologies
(C) race relations in Britain and America can be traced back to colonial times
(D) people choose their racial identity and this becomes fixed
reference_answer: (B) The idea of race is socially constructed through powerful ideologies.
answer: Sahi answer (B) hai: race ka idea powerful ideologies ke through socially constructed hota hai. Ye theories argue karti hain ki racial categories natural biological divisions nahi hain, balki language, media aur political discourse ke through banai aur maintain ki jaati hain. Aisa discourse social differences ko natural batakar inequality ko justify kar sakta hai.

question:
1 F is theoretically equal to
Options:
(A) 1 ohm of resistance
(B) ratio of 1 V to 1 C
(C) ratio of 1 C to 1 V
(D) none of these
reference_answer: (C) The ratio of 1 C to 1 V.
answer: The answer is (C): the ratio of 1 coulomb to 1 volt. Capacitance is defined as C = Q/V, so a capacitor has a capacitance of one farad if it stores one coulomb of charge when one volt is applied across it. The ohm is the unit of resistance, not capacitance.

question:
According to legend in what country are you most likely to meet a leprechaun?
Options:
(A) Ireland
(B) Poland
(C) Greenland
(D) Scotland
reference_answer: (A) Ireland.
answer: The answer is (A), Ireland. Leprechauns are small, mischievous fairy shoemakers from Irish folklore, often said to hide a pot of gold at the end of the rainbow. They have become a popular symbol of Ireland, especially on St Patrick's Day.

question: Explain this to me like a history teacher. What was the real aim of Akbar's policy of 'sulh-i-kul', and how did it help promote communal harmony and peace in society? Do you think this policy was only meant to strengthen his power, or did he truly want to give all religions equal status?
answer: Sulh-i-kul means "peace with all". Akbar's aim was to rule a vast empire of Hindus, Muslims, Jains, Christians and others without favouring any one group, so that all subjects would see the emperor as fair. He abolished the jizya tax on non-Muslims and the pilgrimage tax, appointed Rajput and other non-Muslim nobles to high posts, and held open religious debates at the Ibadat Khana in Fatehpur Sikri. These steps reduced religious tension and won broad loyalty. Historians debate his motives, but the best answer is probably both: the policy clearly strengthened his authority, yet his personal curiosity about faiths and his long commitment to tolerance suggest genuine conviction as well.

question:
Buffer-overflow may remain as a bug in apps if __________ are not done fully.
Options:
(A) boundary hacks
(B) memory checks
(C) boundary checks
(D) buffer checks
reference_answer: (C) Boundary checks.
answer: Sahi uttar (C) hai, seema jaanch. Buffer overflow tab hota hai jab koi program kisi buffer mein uski kshamata se adhik data likh deta hai, jo paas ki memory mein phail jaata hai. Yah jaanchna ki har lekhan buffer ki seemaaon ke bheetar rahe, is dosh ko rokta hai.

question: Describe the process and write out the balanced chemical equation for the reaction that occurs when solid calcium carbonate reacts with hydrochloric acid to form aqueous calcium chloride, carbon dioxide, and water. What type of reaction is this, and what observations might indicate that the reaction is taking place?
answer: Jab thos calcium carbonate ko hydrochloric aml mein daala jaata hai, to aml carbonate se abhikriya karke calcium chloride, jal aur carbon dioxide gas banaata hai. Santulit sameekaran hai: CaCO₃(s) + 2HCl(aq) → CaCl₂(aq) + H₂O(l) + CO₂(g). Yah aml–carbonate abhikriya hai, jo ek prakaar ki dvivisthaapan abhikriya hai, jismein bana carbonic aml turant jal aur carbon dioxide mein toot jaata hai. Abhikriya hone ke sanketon mein CO₂ nikalne se jhaag ya bulbule banna, thos ka dheere-dheere gaayab hona aur mishran ka halka garm hona shaamil hain. Gas ko choone ke paani se guzaarne par vah doodhiya ho jaata hai, jisse carbon dioxide ki pushti hoti hai.

question:
A box sits on an inclined plane without sliding. As the angle of the plane (measured from the horizontal) increases, the normal force
Options:
(A) increases linearly
(B) decreases linearly
(C) does not change
(D) decreases nonlinearly
reference_answer: (D) Decreases nonlinearly (N = mg cos θ).
answer: सही उत्तर (D) है: यह अरैखिक रूप से घटता है। ढलान पर रखे डिब्बे पर अभिलंब बल mg cos θ के बराबर होता है, जहाँ θ ढलान का कोण है। चूँकि कोसाइन रैखिक फलन नहीं है, इसलिए कोण बढ़ने पर अभिलंब बल पहले धीरे-धीरे और फिर तेज़ी से घटता है।

question:
Relative error is same as
Options:
(A) ratio of absolute error and true value.
(B) absolute error.
(C) true error.
(D) none of the above.
reference_answer: (A) The absolute error divided by the true value.
answer: The answer is (A): the ratio of the absolute error to the true value. Absolute error is the difference between a measured value and the true value, and dividing it by the true value expresses the error as a fraction or percentage. For example, an error of 2 cm in a 100 cm length is a relative error of 0.02, or 2%.

question:
Which muscles are normally active during quiet inspiration?
Options:
(A) External and internal intercostal muscles
(B) External intercostal muscles and diaphragm
(C) Internal intercostal muscles and diaphragm
(D) External and internal intercostal muscles and diaphragm
reference_answer: (B) External intercostal muscles and diaphragm.
answer: सही उत्तर (B) है: बाह्य अंतरापर्शुक पेशियाँ और मध्यपट। शांत श्वसन में मध्यपट सिकुड़कर चपटा हो जाता है और बाह्य अंतरापर्शुक पेशियाँ पसलियों को ऊपर उठाती हैं, जिससे वक्ष गुहा बड़ी हो जाती है। आंतरिक अंतरापर्शुक पेशियाँ मुख्य रूप से बलपूर्वक निःश्वसन में काम आती हैं, शांत अंतःश्वसन में नहीं।

question:
Which of the following fallacies happen if someone argues that you are a reasonable and intelligent person, so of course you understand his claim is true?
Options:
(A) significance
(B) argument from authority
(C) appeal to pride
(D) slippery slope
reference_answer: (C) Appeal to pride.
answer: The answer is (C), appeal to pride. The arguer flatters you as reasonable and intelligent so that you will accept the claim to protect that image, rather than because of any evidence. It is a form of appeal to emotion, not an argument from authority.

question:
The fallacy of appeal to emotions consists of
Options:
(A) trying to make an opponent's argument seem ridiculous
(B) defending wrongdoing by claiming the opposing arguer does the same thing
(C) arguing that an argument should be rejected because the source of the argument
(D) trying to get someone else to agree to a claim only by arousing that person's feelings about the subject
reference_answer: (D) Getting agreement only by arousing the person's feelings about the subject.
answer: Sahi answer (D) hai: kisi person ko sirf subject ke baare mein uski feelings arouse karke kisi claim se agree karwane ki koshish karna. Evidence dene ke bajaye arguer agreement paane ke liye fear, pity, anger ya pride ka sahara leta hai. Opponent ke argument ko ridiculous dikhana ek alag fallacy hai, ridicule.

question:
Where is the sinoatrial node located?
Options:
(A) Between the left atrium and the left ventricle
(B) Between the right atrium and the right ventricle
(C) In the upper wall of the right atrium
(D) In the upper wall of the left ventricle
reference_answer: (C) In the upper wall of the right atrium.
answer: Sahi answer (C) hai: right atrium ki upper wall mein, superior vena cava ke opening ke paas. Sinoatrial node heart ka natural pacemaker hai, jo har heartbeat start karne wale electrical impulses generate karta hai. Atria aur ventricles ke beech wala node atrioventricular node hai.

question:
What is a major limitation of using BMI (body mass index) as a method of body fat measurements?
Options:
(A) It is not an accurate measure for average people
(B) It is more accurate than height-weight tables
(C) It does not distinguish between fat and fat free mass
(D) All of the above
reference_answer: (C) It does not distinguish between fat and fat-free mass.
answer: Sahi answer (C) hai: BMI fat aur fat-free mass mein difference nahi karta. Ise sirf weight aur height se calculate kiya jaata hai, isliye ek muscular athlete ko kam body fat hone ke bawajood overweight maana ja sakta hai. Ye is baare mein bhi kuch nahi batata ki fat body mein kahan store hai.

question:
A valid disjunctive syllogism has a major premise that:
Options:
(A) includes two or more alternatives
(B) classifies subjects
(C) affirms the antecedent or denies the consequent
(D) leads to a valid conclusion
reference_answer: (A) It includes two or more alternatives.
answer: Sahi uttar (A) hai: aisa mukhya aadhaar-vaakya jismein do ya adhik vikalp hon. Viyojak nyaayavaakya "ya to...ya" waale kathan se shuru hota hai, jaise "Ya to baarish ho rahi hai ya favvaare chal rahe hain." Gaun aadhaar-vaakya ek vikalp ko khaarij karta hai, aur nishkarsh bache hue vikalp ki pushti karta hai.

question:
The units for the rate of a chemical reaction are
Options:
(A) L2 mol-2 s-1
(B) mol L-1 s-1
(C) L mol-1 s-1
(D) it depends on the particular reaction
reference_answer: (B) mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹.
answer: सही उत्तर (B) है, mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹। अभिक्रिया की दर किसी अभिकारक या उत्पाद की सांद्रता में प्रति इकाई समय होने वाला परिवर्तन है, और सांद्रता मोल प्रति लीटर में मापी जाती है। दर स्थिरांक की इकाइयाँ अभिक्रिया की कोटि पर निर्भर करती हैं, लेकिन स्वयं दर की इकाइयाँ नहीं।

question: Write an engaging opening paragraph for a fictional story in which a child discovers that he can talk to animals.
answer: Apne tenth birthday ki morning Arjun hens ke liye grain scatter kar raha tha, tabhi unmein se ek ne upar dekhkar bilkul clearly kaha, "Tumne phir se Rani ko mujhse double de diya." Arjun wahin freeze ho gaya, steel ka bowl uske haathon mein kaanpne laga. Uske peeche boodhi buffalo ne hansi mein snort kiya, aur neem tree se ek crow ne call kiya, "Finally is ghar mein koi toh hai jo sunta hai." Arjun ne khaali courtyard mein chaaron taraf dekha, sochte hue ki kahin woh dream toh nahi dekh raha, lekin hen ab bhi use ghoor rahi thi, sorry ka wait karte hue. Shaam tak usne do cheezein seekh li: village ke har animal ki apni opinion thi, aur unmein se kisi ko bhi forest se hokar ban rahi new road pasand nahi thi.

question:
Why is Mahavira a significant person in the Jaina traditions?
Options:
(A) He is the last of the ascetic prophets.
(B) He is the first of the ascetic prophets
(C) He is the most learned of the ascetic prophets
(D) He is the most holy of the ascetic prophets
reference_answer: (A) He is the last (24th) Tirthankara of the present age.
answer: सही उत्तर (A) है: महावीर तपस्वी तीर्थंकरों में अंतिम हैं। जैन धर्म में वे वर्तमान कालचक्र के 24वें और अंतिम तीर्थंकर हैं, जो पार्श्वनाथ के बाद आए। वे इस परंपरा के संस्थापक नहीं थे, बल्कि उन्होंने ईसा पूर्व छठी-पाँचवीं शताब्दी में जैन समुदाय को पुनर्गठित किया।

question:
Which term describes the forces that unify and strengthen a country?
Options:
(A) Diffusion
(B) Centrifugal
(C) Centripetal
(D) Ethnocentric
reference_answer: (C) Centripetal.
answer: Sahi uttar (C) hai, abhikendri bal. Saajhi bhasha, raashtriya prateek, samaan dharm ya mazboot arthvyavastha jaise abhikendri bal kisi desh ke logon ko aapas mein jodte hain. Apkendri bal iska ulta karte hain aur jaatiya, dhaarmik ya kshetriya tanaavon ke zariye raajya ko baantte hain.

question:
"Get cookie," best exemplifies
Options:
(A) babbling
(B) cooing
(C) holophrases
(D) telegraphic speech
reference_answer: (D) Telegraphic speech.
answer: Sahi answer (D) hai, telegraphic speech. Lagbhag do saal ki age mein bachche do ya zyada words combine karne lagte hain aur chhote grammatical words chhod dete hain, bilkul purane telegram ki tarah, jaise "Get cookie" ya "Daddy go". Holophrases single words hain jo poora idea express karte hain, aur babbling aur cooing isse pehle aate hain.

question:
Which would be the easiest way to burn a copper penny?
Options:
(A) Hold the copper penny with crucible tongs, and heat strongly in the flame of a Bunsen burner.
(B) Use the method in (A), but use an oxyacetylene torch to reach a higher temperature.
(C) Grind the copper penny into very small, dust-sized particles, and spray the particles into a Bunsen burner flame.
(D) Dissolve the copper penny in acid, precipitate the hydroxide, and heat in a Bunsen burner flame to make the oxide.
reference_answer: (C) Grind it to dust and spray it into the flame; the large surface area lets it burn.
answer: सही उत्तर (C) है। सिक्के को बारीक धूल में पीसने से उसका पृष्ठ क्षेत्रफल बहुत बढ़ जाता है, जिससे एक साथ कहीं अधिक तांबे के परमाणु ऑक्सीजन के संपर्क में आते हैं और कण साधारण बुन्सेन ज्वाला में तेज़ी से जल जाते हैं। ठोस सिक्का बहुत जल्दी ऊष्मा खो देता है, इसलिए अधिक गर्म टॉर्च से भी नहीं जलता, और विकल्प (D) धातु को जलाने के बजाय केवल रासायनिक रूप से कॉपर ऑक्साइड बनाता है।

question:
The output of the system has an effect upon the input quantity, then the system is a
Options:
(A) open loop control system.
(B) closed loop control system.
(C) either A or B.
(D) none of the above.
reference_answer: (B) Closed-loop control system.
answer: सही उत्तर (B) है, संवृत-पाश नियंत्रण प्रणाली। संवृत-पाश प्रणाली में निर्गत को मापकर वापस भेजा जाता है ताकि निवेश को समायोजित किया जा सके, जैसे तापस्थापी कमरे के तापमान के अनुसार हीटर को चालू या बंद करता है। विवृत-पाश प्रणाली में निर्गत का निवेश पर कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता।

question:
When an appeal is made to the Supreme Court, the court usually
Options:
(A) refuses to hear the appeal
(B) declares a mistrial
(C) orders the lower court to retry the case
(D) rules in favor of the defendant
reference_answer: (A) It usually refuses to hear the appeal.
answer: The answer is (A): it usually refuses to hear the appeal. The Supreme Court receives several thousand petitions each year but grants review in fewer than 100 cases, usually around 60 to 70. When it denies certiorari, the lower court's decision stands.

question: Provide insights into the correlation between economic indicators such as GDP, inflation, and unemployment rates. Explain how fiscal and monetary policies affect those indicators.
answer: GDP, inflation and unemployment are closely linked. When GDP grows quickly, firms hire more workers, so unemployment tends to fall; this inverse link is known as Okun's law. Strong demand can also push prices up, so fast growth and low unemployment are often accompanied by higher inflation, a short-run trade-off described by the Phillips curve. Fiscal policy, meaning government spending and taxes, can raise GDP and cut unemployment by boosting demand, but may add to inflation. Monetary policy works through interest rates: a central bank raises rates to cool inflation, which slows growth, and cuts them to support growth and jobs.

question:
Yeast cells carry out both aerobic and anaerobic respiration. A yeast cell that is fed on glucose is moved from an aerobic to an anaerobic environment. Which of the following statements is correct and gives the correct reason for it?
Options:
(A) The cell dies because it cannot make ATP.
(B) The cell would need to consume glucose at a much greater rate because aerobic respiration is much more efficient as compared with anaerobic respiration.
(C) The cell would need to consume another food source other than glucose because it will not be able to make adequate ATP with only glucose.
(D) The cell will begin to divide rapidly because larger cells require more oxygen and glucose than smaller ones.
reference_answer: (B) It must consume glucose much faster because anaerobic respiration yields far less ATP.
answer: सही उत्तर (B) है। ऑक्सीजन के बिना यीस्ट किण्वन करने लगता है, जिससे प्रति ग्लूकोज़ अणु केवल 2 ATP मिलते हैं, जबकि वायवीय श्वसन से लगभग 30 या उससे अधिक मिलते हैं। उतनी ही ऊर्जा की ज़रूरत पूरी करने के लिए कोशिका को ग्लूकोज़ बहुत तेज़ी से तोड़ना पड़ता है; वह मरती नहीं है।

question: Imagine you are a lush forest where trees have stood for centuries. One day some tourists come, damage the trees and spread litter. How do you feel when they do all this?
answer: Sadiyon se mere ped shaant saath mein khade hain, unki jadein mitti ke neeche aapas mein gunthi hain aur shaakhaayein pakshiyon ke geeton se bhari hain. Jab paryatak aate hain, to pehle main unka swaagat karta hoon, khush hokar ki log ab bhi meri chhaaya mein aaraam karne aate hain. Lekin phir ve meri chhaal par apne naam khodte hain, nayi shaakhaayein tod dete hain aur fern ke beech plastic ki botalein aur panniyaan chhod jaate hain. Mujhe chot aur apmaan mehsoos hota hai, us mezbaan ki tarah jiska ghar laaparvaah mehmaanon ne raund diya ho. Mujhe sabse zyaada chinta un jeevon ki hoti hai jo bol nahi sakte: ve hiran jo plastic nigal sakte hain, ve paudhe jo pairon tale kuchal jaate hain. Kaash paryatak keval tasveerein le jaayein, keval padchihn chhodein, aur yaad rakhein ki ve ek jeevit ghar mein mehmaan hain.

question:
Let x = 1. What is x << 3 in Python 3?
Options:
(A) 1
(B) 3
(C) 8
(D) 16
answer: The answer is (C), 8. The << operator shifts the bits of a number to the left, and each shift multiplies it by 2. Shifting 1 (binary 1) left by three places gives binary 1000, which is 8.

question:

question:

question:

question: Now you are a geography expert. Your task is to explain complex geographical concepts simply so that ordinary people can understand them. Let's begin with this question: 'What is the extent of the Indian subcontinent? Which major geographical features does it include?'
answer: The Indian subcontinent is the large landmass of South Asia that sits largely on the Indian tectonic plate. question: What is the central dogma of molecular biology? What processes are involved? Who named this?

question:

question:
When an influenza virus enters a cell, it immediately starts to do which of the following?

(B) Destroy the host cell’s transcriptional machinery
(C) Replicate its genetic material and synthesize viral proteins
(D) Use a viral copy of reverse transcriptase to manufacture viral DNA
reference_answer: (C) Replicate its genetic material and synthesize viral proteins.
answer: Sahi answer (C) hai: ye apne genetic material ko replicate karta hai aur viral proteins synthesize karta hai. Influenza ek RNA virus hai, jo apne RNA genome ko apne RNA polymerase se copy karta hai aur viral proteins banane ke liye host ke ribosomes use karta hai. Ye retrovirus nahi hai, isliye ye reverse transcriptase se DNA nahi banata aur na hi host chromosome mein integrate hota hai.

question:
Say's Law
Options:
(A) is the basis of Keynesian economic analysis.
(B) is the basis of Classical economic analysis.
(C) states that demand creates its own supply.
(D) indicates that prices will be stable in capitalist economies.
reference_answer: (B) It is the basis of Classical economic analysis.
answer: The answer is (B): it is the basis of Classical economic analysis. Say's Law states that supply creates its own demand, because producing goods generates the income needed to buy them. Classical economists used it to argue that general overproduction and long-term unemployment are unlikely, a view Keynes later rejected.

question: Photosynthesis is a vital process for life on Earth. Could you outline the two main stages of photosynthesis, including where they take place within the chloroplast, and the primary inputs and outputs for each stage?
answer: Photosynthesis ke do main stages hote hain. Light-dependent reactions chloroplast ki thylakoid membranes mein hoti hain. Inke inputs light energy, water aur carriers ADP aur NADP+ hain, aur outputs oxygen, ATP aur NADPH hain. Light-independent reactions, yaani Calvin cycle, stroma mein hoti hain. Ye first stage se mile ATP aur NADPH ke saath carbon dioxide use karti hain, aur glucose (sugar G3P ke through) produce karti hain, saath hi ADP aur NADP+ wapas light reactions ko de deti hain.

question: You are a wildlife expert with a deep understanding of Indian animals, birds and their environment. You help farmers whose crops are often destroyed by wild animals. A farmer comes to you and says that herds of nilgai, wild boar and monkeys destroy the crops in his field almost every day. He does not want to harm these animals, but he also needs to protect his crop. Please suggest detailed solutions using Indian traditional knowledge, natural remedies and modern technology, so that the crop is protected and the animals are not harmed.
answer: You can protect your crop without harming the animals by combining several methods. Traditional and natural methods: plant a border of thorny or strong-smelling crops such as lemongrass, castor, chilli or sisal, which nilgai and boar avoid; spray a mix of cow dung, cow urine and neem or chilli, whose smell deters them; and keep guard dogs, which work well against monkeys and boar. Modern methods: install a solar-powered electric fence that gives a harmless shock, use motion-sensor lights and alarms or bio-acoustic devices that play predator sounds, and use bird-scaring tape. Cooperate with neighbouring farmers to fence a whole area together, and contact the forest department about support schemes and compensation for crop losses.

question:

Ye informal customs se lekar formal laws tak hote hain, aur inhe todne par usually kisi na kisi form mein disapproval ya sanction milta hai.

question:
A student pushes a puck across a table, moving it from position x = 0 to position x = 0.2 m. After he lets go, the puck continues to travel across the table, coming to rest at position x = 1.2 m. When the puck is at position x = 1.0 m, which of the following is a correct assertion about the net force on the puck?
Options:
(A) The net force is in the negative direction, because the puck is moving in the positive direction but slowing down.
(B) The net force is down, because the puck is near the Earth, where gravitational acceleration is 10 m/s^2 downward.
(C) The net force is in the positive direction, because the student’s push caused the puck to speed up in the positive direction.
(D) The net force is zero, because the student’s push in the positive direction must equal the force of friction in the negative direction.
reference_answer: (A) Negative direction, because the puck is slowing down.
answer: सही उत्तर (A) है: कुल बल ऋणात्मक दिशा में है। x = 1.0 m पर छात्र अब धक्का नहीं दे रहा, और पक धनात्मक दिशा में चलते हुए धीमा हो रहा है। धीमा होने का अर्थ है कि उसका त्वरण, और इसलिए कुल बल (घर्षण), उसकी गति की विपरीत दिशा में है।

question: What is the main problem associated with landfills in India, and what effective management practices and policies can be implemented to deal with it? In addition, can community participation and awareness campaigns make any special contribution in this direction?
answer: The main problem is that India's landfills receive huge amounts of mixed, unsegregated waste, so most urban dumps are overflowing open sites rather than engineered landfills. Rotting organic waste releases methane, which causes frequent fires, and leachate seeps into groundwater, harming the health of nearby residents. Effective solutions start with segregating waste at source into wet, dry and hazardous streams, as required by the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016. Wet waste can be composted or turned into biogas, dry waste recycled, and old dumps cleared by biomining. Community participation is essential: awareness campaigns, such as those under the Swachh Bharat Mission, change household habits and make segregation and recycling work in practice.

question: Discuss the concept of solidarity in human societies. Analyse how collective action and mutual support help humans overcome challenges and achieve common goals.
answer: Solidarity unity aur shared responsibility ki woh feeling hai jo kisi group ke members ko bandhti hai aur unhe ek-doosre ko support karne ke liye motivate karti hai. Sociologist Emile Durkheim ne chhoti traditional communities mein similarity par based mechanical solidarity aur complex modern societies mein interdependence par based organic solidarity mein difference kiya. Collective action is feeling ko results mein badalta hai: milkar effort karne wale log woh achieve kar sakte hain jo akele individuals nahi kar sakte, jaise villagers ka milkar well banana, workers ka union banana, ya citizens ka independence ya civil rights movements mein join karna. Mutual support shared resources, volunteering aur care ke through logon ko floods ya pandemics jaise crises se nikalne mein bhi help karta hai. Is tarah solidarity trust aur resilience build karti hai, jisse common goals achievable bante hain.

question: Consider a satellite that is in a circular orbit around the Earth. The speed of the satellite decreases. What will happen to the satellite's orbital radius and period of revolution? Please justify your answer using principles of physics.
answer: Vrittaakaar kaksha mein upgrah ke liye gurutva hi abhikendra bal pradaan karta hai, isliye GMm/r² = mv²/r, jisse v = √(GM/r) milta hai. Atah kaksheeya veg trijya ke vargmool ke vyutkramaanupaati hai: vrittaakaar kaksha mein dheeme chalne waale upgrah ko prithvi se adhik door hona chahiye. Isliye yadi upgrah ka veg ghatata hai aur vah vrittaakaar kaksha mein bana rehta hai, to uski kaksheeya trijya badh jaati hai. Uska parikraman kaal, T = 2πr/v, bhi badhta hai, kyonki path lamba ho jaata hai jabki veg ghatata hai; yah Kepler ke teesre niyam, T² ∝ r³, se mel khaata hai.

question:
Theories of racialized discourse suggest that:
Options:
(A) race is an objective way of categorizing people on biological grounds
(B) the idea of race is socially constructed through powerful ideologies
(C) race relations in Britain and America can be traced back to colonial times
(D) people choose their racial identity and this becomes fixed
reference_answer: (B) The idea of race is socially constructed through powerful ideologies.
answer: The answer is (B): the idea of race is socially constructed through powerful ideologies. These theories argue that racial categories are not natural biological divisions but are created and maintained through language, media and political discourse. Such discourse can justify inequality by presenting social differences as natural.

question:
A charged particle moves through a magnetic field and experiences a force f. New particles are sent into the same magnetic field. If the new particles have twice the charge, twice the mass, and twice the velocity, the new force would be
Options:
(A) 4F
(B) 2F
(C) F
(D) 1/2 F
reference_answer: (A) 4F, since F = qvB does not depend on mass.
answer: The answer is (A), 4F. The magnetic force on a moving charge is F = qvB, so it depends on charge and velocity but not on mass. Doubling both the charge and the velocity multiplies the force by 2 × 2 = 4.

question: Craft an intriguing opening paragraph for a fictional short story. The story should involve a character who wakes up one morning to find that they can time travel.

question:
When the Supreme Court decides to take a case on appeal it
Options:
(A) issues a writ of habeas corpus
(B) issues a writ of certiorari
(C) issues amicus curiae briefs
(D) engages in judicial review
reference_answer: (B) It issues a writ of certiorari.
answer: The answer is (B): it issues a writ of certiorari. A writ of certiorari is the order by which the Supreme Court agrees to review a lower court's decision, usually after at least four justices vote to hear the case. Habeas corpus concerns unlawful detention, amicus curiae briefs are filed by outside parties, and judicial review is the power to strike down laws.

question: Explain this to me like a history teacher. What was the real aim of Akbar's policy of 'sulh-i-kul', and how did it help promote communal harmony and peace in society? Do you think this policy was only meant to strengthen his power, or did he truly want to give all religions equal status?
answer: सुलह-ए-कुल का अर्थ है "सबके साथ शांति"। अकबर का उद्देश्य हिंदुओं, मुसलमानों, जैनों, ईसाइयों और अन्य लोगों के एक विशाल साम्राज्य पर किसी एक समूह का पक्ष लिए बिना शासन करना था, ताकि सभी प्रजाजन सम्राट को न्यायप्रिय मानें। उन्होंने गैर-मुसलमानों पर लगने वाला जज़िया कर और तीर्थयात्रा कर समाप्त किया, राजपूत और अन्य गैर-मुस्लिम सरदारों को ऊँचे पदों पर नियुक्त किया, और फ़तेहपुर सीकरी के इबादतखाने में खुली धार्मिक चर्चाएँ करवाईं। इन कदमों से धार्मिक तनाव कम हुआ और व्यापक निष्ठा मिली। इतिहासकार उनके उद्देश्यों पर बहस करते हैं, लेकिन सबसे उचित उत्तर शायद दोनों है: इस नीति ने स्पष्ट रूप से उनकी सत्ता मज़बूत की, फिर भी विभिन्न धर्मों के प्रति उनकी व्यक्तिगत जिज्ञासा और सहिष्णुता के प्रति लंबी प्रतिबद्धता सच्चे विश्वास का भी संकेत देती है।

question: Imagine you are participating in a race with a group of people. If you have just overtaken the second person, what's your current position? Where is the person you just overtook?
answer: You are now in second place. Overtaking the person in second position means you take their place, not first place, since the leader is still ahead of you. The person you just overtook has dropped back one position and is now in third place.

question:
According to the Solar Nebular theory what are asteroids and comets?
Options:
(A) They are the shattered remains of collisions between planets.
(B) They are chunks of rock or ice that condensed long after the planets and moons had formed.
(C) They are chunks of rock or ice that were expelled from planets by volcanoes.
(D) They are leftover planetesimals that never accreted into planets.
reference_answer: (D) Leftover planetesimals that never accreted into planets.
answer: सही उत्तर (D) है: ये बचे हुए ग्रहाणु हैं जो कभी ग्रहों में नहीं जुड़े। सौर नीहारिका सिद्धांत में पहले चट्टान और बर्फ़ के छोटे पिंड बने, जो धीरे-धीरे आपस में जुड़कर ग्रह बने। क्षुद्रग्रह और धूमकेतु वे टुकड़े हैं जो कभी इकट्ठे नहीं हुए, इसलिए उनमें प्रारंभिक सौर मंडल का पदार्थ सुरक्षित है।

question:
The mutation in sickle-cell disease consists of:

question:
Which muscles are normally active during quiet inspiration?

answer: Sahi uttar (B) hai: baahya antaraparshuk peshiyaan aur madhyapat. Shaant shvasan mein madhyapat sikudkar chapta ho jaata hai aur baahya antaraparshuk peshiyaan pasliyon ko upar uthaati hain, jisse vaksh guha badi ho jaati hai. question:
How many major powers are there in a multipolar system?
Options:

reference_answer: (D) Three or more.
answer: Sahi uttar (D) hai, teen ya usse adhik. Bahudhruveeya vyavastha vah hai jismein shakti teen ya usse adhik badi shaktiyon mein bati hoti hai, jaise pratham vishva yuddh se pehle ka Europe. question: Write a descriptive paragraph about the effects of the monsoon in India. Include sensory details such as the sound of rain, the earthy smell of wet soil and the greenery spreading all around, and also explain its effect on daily life and agriculture.
answer: Jab finally India mein monsoon aata hai, toh pehli drops tin roofs par hazaron tiny hands ki tarah drum karti hain, aur jaldi hi baarish silver sheets ki tarah roar karte hue girne lagti hai. Pyaasi dharti apni sweet, earthy fragrance chhodti hai, wet soil ki woh smell jiska sab poori summer wait karte hain. Kuch hi dinon mein brown fields aur dusty hills vivid green ho jaate hain, aur frogs aur peacocks apni calls se evenings ko bhar dete hain. Daily life bhi change hoti hai: streets flood ho jaati hain, trains late chalti hain aur har jagah umbrellas khil uthte hain, jabki bachche khushi se puddles mein splash karte hain. Farmers ke liye baarish khud life hai, jo ponds aur wells ko bharti hai aur rice, cotton aur doosri kharif crops ki sowing possible banati hai, jo desh ka pet bharti hain.

question:
Which would be the easiest way to burn a copper penny?

(B) Use the method in (A), but use an oxyacetylene torch to reach a higher temperature.

reference_answer: (C) Grind it to dust and spray it into the flame; the large surface area lets it burn.
answer: Sahi uttar (C) hai. Sikke ko baareek dhool mein peesne se uska prishth kshetraphal bahut badh jaata hai, jisse ek saath kahin adhik taambe ke parmaanu oxygen ke sampark mein aate hain aur kan saadhaaran Bunsen jvaala mein tezi se jal jaate hain. Thos sikka bahut jaldi ushma kho deta hai, isliye adhik garm torch se bhi nahi jalta, aur vikalp (D) dhaatu ko jalaane ke bajaay keval raasaayanik roop se copper oxide banaata hai.

question:
What was the required labor service owed to the king in return for the privilege of using property owned by the Incan empire?
Options:
(A) Khipu
(B) Mit'a
(C) Split inheritance
(D) Capacocha
reference_answer: (B) Mit'a.
answer: The answer is (B), mit'a. Under the mit'a system, households in the Inca empire owed the state periodic labour, such as farming state lands, building roads or serving in the army, in return for access to land. Khipu were knotted cords used for record-keeping, and capacocha was a ritual child sacrifice.

question: Describe the process and write out the balanced chemical equation for the reaction that occurs when solid calcium carbonate reacts with hydrochloric acid to form aqueous calcium chloride, carbon dioxide, and water. What type of reaction is this, and what observations might indicate that the reaction is taking place?
answer: Jab solid calcium carbonate ko hydrochloric acid mein daala jaata hai, toh acid carbonate se react karke calcium chloride, water aur carbon dioxide gas banata hai. Balanced equation hai: CaCO₃(s) + 2HCl(aq) → CaCl₂(aq) + H₂O(l) + CO₂(g). Ye acid–carbonate reaction hai, jo ek type ka double displacement reaction hai, jismein bana carbonic acid turant water aur carbon dioxide mein break ho jaata hai. Reaction hone ke signs mein CO₂ nikalne se fizzing ya bubbles banna, solid ka dheere-dheere gayab hona aur mixture ka halka garam hona shaamil hain. Gas ko limewater se pass karne par woh milky ho jaata hai, jisse carbon dioxide confirm hoti hai.

question:
What is dualism?

(B) Under dualism, international and domestic laws comprise distinct legal Systems

answer: Sahi uttar (B) hai. Dvaitvaad ke anusaar antarraashtriya kaanoon aur gharelu kaanoon do alag-alag vidhi pranaaliyaan hain, isliye koi sandhi kisi raajya ke bheetar tab tak prabhaavi nahi hoti jab tak raashtriya vidhaan use gharelu kaanoon mein parivartit na kar de. question:
Which language family contains Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, and Romanian?
Options:
(A) European
(B) Slavic
(C) Germanic
(D) Romance
reference_answer: (D) Romance; these languages descend from Latin.
answer: The answer is (D), the Romance language family. Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and Romanian all developed from Vulgar Latin, the everyday Latin spoken across the Roman Empire. Slavic and Germanic are separate branches of the Indo-European family, and 'European' is not a language family.

question:
Relative error is same as
Options:
(A) ratio of absolute error and true value.
(B) absolute error.

reference_answer: (A) The absolute error divided by the true value.

question:

question:
What is a major limitation of using BMI (body mass index) as a method of body fat measurements?

answer: The answer is (C): BMI does not distinguish between fat and fat-free mass. It is calculated only from weight and height, so a muscular athlete can be classed as overweight despite having little body fat. It also says nothing about where fat is stored.

question:
The fallacy of appeal to emotions consists of
Options:

question: What were the main methods Mahatma Gandhi used to challenge the social and political problems of his time?
answer: Gandhi's central method was satyagraha, or "truth-force": resisting injustice through non-violent action and a willingness to suffer rather than to harm opponents. He led mass civil disobedience, such as the 1930 Salt March, and non-cooperation campaigns that encouraged Indians to boycott British goods, courts and schools. He promoted swadeshi and khadi, urging people to spin and wear Indian cloth as a sign of self-reliance. He used fasting as moral pressure and worked against social evils, campaigning against untouchability and for Hindu–Muslim unity. Throughout, he relied on personal example and simple living to mobilise ordinary people.

question:

question: Provide insights into the correlation between economic indicators such as GDP, inflation, and unemployment rates. Explain how fiscal and monetary policies affect those indicators.

question: Describe five key principles in evaluating an argument in analytical writing.
answer: Five key principles help in evaluating an argument. First, identify the claim: be clear about exactly what the author wants you to accept. Second, examine the evidence: check whether it is relevant, reliable and sufficient to support the claim. Third, test the reasoning: look for logical gaps or fallacies, such as confusing correlation with causation. Fourth, uncover assumptions: ask what unstated beliefs the argument depends on and whether they hold. Fifth, consider alternatives: think about counterarguments or other explanations the author has ignored, and judge whether the argument still stands.

question: Imagine you are Chanakya, the great economist and political scholar of ancient India. A king comes to you seeking advice on improving his kingdom's economy. question: Imagine you are a lush forest where trees have stood for centuries. One day some tourists come, damage the trees and spread litter. How do you feel when they do all this?

question: Now you are a machine learning engineer. Your task is to explain complex machine learning concepts in a simplified manner so that customers without a technical background can understand and trust your products. Let's start with the question: "What is a language model? Is it trained using labeled or unlabelled data?"
answer: A language model is a computer program that has learned how language works by reading a huge amount of text. Its basic skill is predicting which word is likely to come next in a sentence, and by doing this over and over it can answer questions, summarise documents or write emails. It is mostly trained on unlabelled data: ordinary text from books and websites, where the "answer" for each step is simply the next word already in the text, so no one has to label it by hand. Many models are then fine-tuned with a smaller amount of labelled or human-rated examples to make them more helpful and safe.

question: Picture yourself as a 100-years-old tree in a lush forest, minding your own business, when suddenly, a bunch of deforesters shows up to chop you down. How do you feel when those guys start hacking away at you?
answer: Sau varshon se main yahaan khada hoon, rituon ko badalte dekhta raha hoon, apni shaakhaaon mein pakshiyon ko aashray deta raha hoon aur mere tane se tek lagaakar sustaane waale har raahi ko chhaaya deta raha hoon. question:

reference_answer: (C) Boundary checks.

question:

question:
Do individuals (physical) persons enjoy international legal personality in the same manner as States and international organisations?
